About.title: Overview
About.des: In the heart of Istria, on the edge of the peaceful town of Vodnjan, lies a villa that breathes harmony and elegance. Surrounded by olive trees and Mediterranean herbs, hidden from the bustle and noise, it has become a refuge for those seeking rest in its purest form.
About.des2: Outside, there is a private pool surrounded by Mediterranean scenery. This villa seamlessly combines timeless aesthetics with modern comfort, offering a serene oasis.

the_space.title: The Space
the_space.des: The villa has the soul of a home. There are wardrobes scented with lavender, a library where time stands still, a children’s corner full of smiles and colorful toys, and a wellness area that embraces the scent of wood and steam. The sauna and jacuzzi become a ritual, a moment of complete silence and relaxation.
the_space.des2: In the garden, under the shade of the pergola, the days pass slowly. On the table – fresh fruit, a glass of Istrian wine, and a view that disappears into greenery. By the pool – sun-warmed stone and the sound of laughter spreading through the space. In the evening, as the sky fills with sunset colors, the smell of barbecue fills the air, and the terrace lights turn the yard into an intimate theater under the stars.

guest_access.title: Guest Access
guest_access.des: Jacuzzi, Table Tennis, Barbecue, and much more.

locations.title: What to See and Visit:
des: - Explore the beautiful islands of Brijuni National Park, rich in natural beauty and cultural heritage.
- Discover the ancient Roman amphitheater in Pula, one of the best-preserved Roman arenas in the world.
- Dive into the underwater world at Pula Aquarium, located near the city center. Explore diverse marine ecosystems, observe various fish species, and learn more about marine conservation.
- Experience thrilling water slides, lazy rivers, and relaxing pools at Istralandia Aquapark near Novigrad. Perfect for families and water lovers, this aquapark offers a fun day for all ages.

Villa_Description.des: In the heart of Istria, on the edge of the peaceful town of Vodnjan, lies a villa that breathes harmony and elegance. Surrounded by olive trees and Mediterranean herbs, hidden from the bustle and noise, it has become a refuge for those seeking rest in its purest form.
Villa_Description.subtitle: The Space
Villa_Description.des2:
In its stone and bold wall tones, there’s a harmony between modern luxury and Istrian spirit. Behind large glass walls spreads a space where the day begins with the aroma of coffee and ends with the gentle sound of pool water. Four rooms, each with its own character, tell a story of comfort, while four bathrooms reflect the play of light and stone.

Outside, there is a private pool surrounded by Mediterranean landscape. This villa flawlessly combines timeless aesthetics with modern comfort, offering a peaceful oasis.

In the garden, under the pergola’s shade, days pass slowly. On the table – fresh fruit, a glass of Istrian wine, and a view lost in greenery. By the pool – sun-warmed stone and the sound of laughter filling the space. In the evening, as the sky glows with sunset colors, the scent of barbecue fills the air, and terrace lights turn the courtyard into an intimate theater under the stars.

This villa is not just a place to stay — it’s an experience. A space where time flows differently, where the spirit of Istria lives in every detail, and where you find peace without searching for it.

Payment_conditions.subtitle: PAYMENT AND RESERVATION TERMS
Payment_conditions.title: Payment and Reservation Terms
Payment_conditions.des: Tourist tax is not included in the price!
Payment_conditions.des2: To secure a reservation, a 30% advance payment of the total amount is required directly to the owner, and the remaining 70% upon arrival.
Payment_conditions.des3: Refundable deposit if everything is in order: €500.
Payment_conditions.des4: Free cancellation available within one week of booking (EXCEPT FOR LAST-MINUTE BOOKINGS, THEN THE DEADLINE IS 48 HOURS). Last-minute booking – two weeks before arrival.
Payment_conditions.des5: On the last day of stay, guests must leave the accommodation by 9:00 AM so other guests can check in from 4:00 PM.
Payment_conditions.des6: Note: Pets are not allowed on the property.

steps.title: Send an Inquiry
steps.des: Please send us an inquiry via the contact form, email, or phone with all the necessary information and your preferred vacation period. Expect a quick response and our best offer.
steps.des2: To confirm your booking, a 30% advance payment is required, and the remaining amount upon arrival. After completing the payment, please notify us, and we’ll send you a booking and payment confirmation. There are two advance payment options: bank transfer or PayPal (debit and credit cards).
steps.subtitle: Bank Transfer
steps.des3: Once payment is completed, we will confirm your reservation. Relax and look forward to your summer vacation at Villa Luxury Ulika, Istria – Croatia!

Environs.title: Vodnjan & Istria
Environs.des: Vodnjan is a charming town located in the heart of Istria, Croatia. Known for its rich history, medieval architecture, and picturesque streets, it offers a glimpse into traditional Istrian life. Surrounded by olive groves, vineyards, and the stunning Adriatic coast, Vodnjan is also famous for its high-quality olive oil production. Nearby attractions include the ancient Roman city of Pula, Brijuni National Park, and beautiful beaches, making it a perfect destination for lovers of nature and history.
Environs.des2: The villa can be reached by car or taxi. Parking is free and available on-site.

Events.title: Our Packages for Unforgettable Celebrations
Events.subtitle:
Would you like to add a special charm to your event and create memories that last?

We’ve prepared three carefully designed packages to suit different occasions – from elegant simplicity to unique experiences that take your breath away. Each package includes **house rental**, ensuring the perfect location for your celebration and unforgettable moments.
Events.p4_des: We offer house rental with a spacious location ideal for organizing larger events. There’s enough space for tent installation, providing flexibility to adapt the ambiance for various occasions – from family celebrations to corporate events. Tent setup can be arranged in cooperation with VISAEM, a trusted partner for professional tent structures and equipment, ensuring quality and safety for every event.

packages.title: BASIC PACKAGE
details: For those who appreciate simplicity with a touch of elegance. Our carefully crafted decorative garland will beautify your space and create a refined atmosphere for any occasion.
Ideal for: small celebrations, intimate gatherings, or events where you wish to highlight beauty in details.

packages.title: STANDARD PACKAGE
details: A combination of elegance and fun! In addition to the garland, this package includes helium balloons that bring playfulness and festivity to the atmosphere. Your guests will feel the special energy, and the whole vibe will be lifted to another level.
Ideal for: birthdays, christenings, corporate celebrations, and any event that deserves an extra touch of festivity.

packages.title: PREMIUM PACKAGE
details: Our most exclusive package is made for those who want more than decoration – they want an experience. In addition to elegant space decoration, it includes an exclusive retro oldtimer ride (up to 1 hour) where you can enjoy and take photos with the car.
Ideal for: anniversaries, celebrations, special gatherings, and events that deserve something different.
